birth.stop: A Coruña, a birth with two dates and two places
birth.date_confidence: contested and unresolved. Saavedra Vázquez argues from the archive for c.1556; Martínez Salazar, the first biographer, gives 1562-1568 and puts the birth not in A Coruña but at Sigrás, in Cambre, a reading López Rodríguez (2023) p.172 endorses. Popular tradition says 1565. No baptismal entry has been located in any of these parishes. The pin follows the Saavedra/Briante reading; the year and the place are both open
